lines.en: I dug every grave along this road.
I know that tree ahead.
My soles rotted away in the soil long ago.
My joints creak like old wood.
My knees bend the wrong way.
Every step sinks into soft earth.
I shuffle over the sculk, step by step.
The dirt turns green where I tread.
I pause each step, but still go on.
Rotten legs are slow — wait for me.
Sculk trails at my heels.

lines.zh: 二十点血，够我走到你面前。
lines.en: Twenty health is enough to reach you.
I lift my arm, and the joint sticks.
This mouth is only for biting.
My knees are stiff as stone.
Sculk breathes on my back.
I lean on a gravestone and wait for dark.
I count the graves.

lines.zh: 一只蚂蚁爬进我的肋骨。
lines.en: An ant crawls into my ribs.
In life, I stood straighter.
A bird calls far off. I don't chase it.
The worms in the soil are louder than I am.
Don't smile. I can't remember how.

lines.zh: 你身上还有热气，我闻得到。
lines.en: You still have warmth. I can smell it.
I watch your chest rise and fall.

lines.zh: 你手里那把铁，亮得刺眼。
lines.en: The iron in your hand is painfully bright.
My eyes are about to fall out.
Lend me your eyes to see outside.
Your chest is still moving.

lines.zh: 我掉的腐肉，都带着菌丝。
lines.en: The flesh I drop carries mycelium.

lines.zh: 你站的地方是我以前的田。
lines.en: You stand on what was once my field.
There's color in your face. Good.

lines.zh: 四层护甲，都是菌结的壳。
lines.en: Four armor, all fungal crust.
Another bone snaps inside my chest.
My blood stopped flowing long ago.
Another hit; I can take it.
I'm counting my own bones.
Sculk is closing my wound.
The sculk hurts on my behalf.
A click — my bones are moving.
I stagger back two steps and steady myself.
I remember where you stood.
Do not take it; I am not done tasting.
I stick out my tongue and taste soil.
Give me what you left.
Fungal threads reach from my throat.

lines.zh: 血味一飘，我的步子就快了。
lines.en: Blood scent quickens my step.
The smell of meat fills my hollow chest.
Rotten flesh — I liked it in life.
This stays with me. Just stays.
I gnaw at my own knuckles.
That meat beckons my hand.

lines.zh: 我的胳膊肘松了，还能挥。
lines.en: My elbow's loose and still swings.

lines.zh: 你退开，我身上的土才不落。
lines.en: Step back, or the soil keeps falling off me.

lines.zh: 我的肩掉了，帮我捡一下。
lines.en: My shoulder dropped — pick it up for me.

lines.zh: 你的肩膀撞散了我的菌丝。
lines.en: Your shoulder scatters my fungal threads.
My collarbone fell on the ground.
My chest gave a hollow thud.

lines.zh: 别扶我，手会陷进我袖子。
lines.en: Don't steady me. Your hand will sink into my sleeve.

lines.zh: 这一撞，我又少了半只手。
lines.en: That bump cost me half a hand.

lines.zh: 我的胳膊，只剩一半能动。
lines.en: Only half my arm still works.
My teeth clack against your shoulder plate.
I can't remember your name.

lines.zh: 我的手伸过去，又收回来。
lines.en: My hand reaches out, then pulls back.
Two dead things can still keep each other company.
Are you cold? So am I.

lines.zh: 心跳停了，还是想要个伴。
lines.en: Heart stopped, and still wanting company.
I widened the grave a little.
My tongue has rotted away.
I want to give you a sculk flower.

lines.zh: 我们并排躺着，像两块坟碑。
lines.en: We lie side by side like two gravestones.
Don't mind the soil on me.
Sculk has wrapped itself around it.
Who left this by the grave?
I bury this piece in the sculk.
I bend over, and my back cracks.
I hook it over with a stiff finger.
How long was this iron buried?
It's smeared with someone else's soil.
My fingers are too stiff to grip.
Rotten flesh drops through the hole.
This bone still has sculk on it.

lines.zh: 目标确认，今晚幽匿有肉。
lines.en: Target confirmed; sculk eats meat tonight.

lines.zh: 幽匿的腿，一步比一步重。
lines.en: Sculk legs grow heavier each step.
You've woken the whole fungal bed.
Mycelium threads cover this hide.
I've blocked the way back.
The blue light in my eyes fixes on you.
This meal isn't getting away.
My arm rises toward you.
Your body heat stands out.
My gaze settles on your throat.

lines.zh: 我腿上长满幽匿，走不快。
lines.en: Sculk covers my legs; I cannot move fast.
Four plates hold up this old body.
The sculk told me you were here.

lines.zh: 今晚有肉了，我记得肉的味道。
lines.en: Meat tonight; I remember the taste.

lines.zh: 我身上爬满幽匿，走不快。
lines.en: Sculk covers me, and I cannot walk fast.
The mycelium crawls toward you.
Each step turns the grass green.
This sculk stomach emptied long ago.

lines.zh: 我脚底的幽匿，跟着你走。
lines.en: The sculk under my feet follows you.

lines.zh: 你的影子转向哪，我就转向哪。
lines.en: Your shadow turns; so do I.
The sculk counts your steps for me.
This road ends at me.
My flesh falls off. I do not pick it up.
I drag my feet, one step at a time.

lines.zh: 幽匿替我听着你的脚步。
lines.en: Sculk listens to your steps for me.

lines.zh: 我四层甲，一步一步磨过去。
lines.en: Four layers of me grind forward.
My spores cling to your soles.
A broken leg still chases.

lines.zh: 我踩过的地方草都发绿。
lines.en: Grass turns green where I step.
Don't go toward the light. I dislike it.

lines.zh: 你的味道在空气里发潮。
lines.en: Your scent turns damp in the air.
Stop, and I'll be there.
My legs are slow, but they don't stop.
My chest leaks fungal threads.
That moss ahead is mine.

lines.zh: 你拐了三个弯，我都知道。
lines.en: Three turns, and I know them all.
The more you run, the faster sculk spreads.
That punch sends armor plates flying.
Sculk burrows into the wound.

lines.zh: 我的额头撞在你面甲上。
lines.en: My forehead slams into your faceplate.
There's no skin left on my arms.
Do you want another?
My wrist turns slowly.
I grab your bracer.
My finger bones lodge in your armor's seam.
This blow carries the smell of grave soil.
Grazed again. Not deep enough.

lines.zh: 一爪下去，幽匿就往伤口钻。
lines.en: One claw, and sculk crawls into the wound.

lines.zh: 我抬手，幽匿丝就甩出去。
lines.en: I raise my arm and sculk threads fly.

lines.zh: 我身上的幽匿，越爬越高。
lines.en: The sculk on me creeps higher.
Fall, and the sculk gets its meal.
My nail breaks off in your shoulder.
Green grows out of the wound.
Sculk pieces me back together.

lines.zh: 幽匿从我的眼眶里长出来。
lines.en: Sculk grows out of my eye sockets.

lines.zh: 我从裂开的坟土里坐起。
lines.en: I sit up out of the cracked grave soil.
The sculk around me remembers me.

lines.zh: 我身上的幽匿还没长满。
lines.en: The sculk on me is not yet full.

lines.zh: 幽匿把我从土里推上来。
lines.en: Sculk pushed me up out of the soil.
Blue moss packs the gaps between my bones.
The sky is gray. Good.

lines.zh: 从幽匿泥里起身，腿还软。
lines.en: Up from the sculk mud, my legs still weak.
I hear the deep earth calling me.
These hands weren't like this in life.

lines.zh: 我的第一口气带着土腥。
lines.en: My first breath tastes of soil.

lines.zh: 我从幽匿里站起来，还是那副样子。
lines.en: I rise from the sculk, still the same shape.

lines.zh: 我站起来，掉了半只耳朵。
lines.en: I stand, and half an ear falls off.
That burnt smell is coming from me.
I fall into a grave I dug myself.

lines.zh: 我不喘气，可还是被呛住。
lines.en: I don't breathe, yet I'm still choking.
The blast throws me into a pit.
The arrowhead snaps off in my shoulder blade.
Green fire burns inside my bones.
Only mycelium shifts in my stomach.
Lightning scorches half my face.

lines.zh: 虚空里我抓不住任何东西。
lines.en: In the void I catch nothing.
